newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Allied to spend $253 million on new pubs.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Allied to spend $253 million on new pubs.

text.p: British pub operator Allied Domecq Plc said Wednesday its retailing arm will spend 150 million pounds ($253 million) on a pub development programme that will create up to 4,000 jobs.

Allied Domecq Retailing, which has over 3,900 managed and leased pubs in Britain, said the programme will involve more than 140 new developments during the next year, including a number of acquisitions.
"The lion's share of the investment will be for the acquisition of new pubs," Martin Grant, managing director of Allied Domecq Leisure, told reporters.
However, the purchases will not produce a significant increase in the number of Allied Domecq's pubs due to planned sales of existing pubs by the company.
The investment programme will focus on the expansion of the company's three market leading brands -- Big Steak Pub with Wacky Warehouse, Firkin and Mr Qs.
Allied Domecq plans to add 43 new pubs in the next year to its family oriented chain of 248 Big Steak Pubs with Wacky Warehouses.
The company said that of the 4,000 new jobs being created over the next 12 months, around 2,200 will be full-time with the rest part-time.
